elements.description:
A request for access to one piece of data – the resource and its classification, the level, how long, a
justification – then where the request stands: pending, approved, denied or expired.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading

properties.name: description
properties.description: One line under the heading

properties.name: resource
properties.description: The data being asked for

properties.name: classifications
properties.description: Classifications' names and tones, merged over the defaults (public, internal, confidential, restricted)

properties.name: levels
properties.default: [ { id: "view", label: "View", description: "See it and query it here" }, { id: "download", label: "Download", description: "Export a copy" }, { id: "edit", label: "Edit", description: "Change and add records" }, ]
properties.description: The access levels to choose from

properties.name: level
properties.description: The picked level's id; by default the first level. Changed by the user unless tc-level-change is prevented

properties.name: durations
properties.default: [ { id: "7d", label: "7 days", days: 7 }, { id: "30d", label: "30 days", days: 30 }, { id: "90d", label: "90 days", days: 90 }, ]
properties.description: The fixed durations to choose from; an end date is always offered, permanent only with `allow-permanent`

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The picked duration: a duration's id, "custom" or "permanent"; by default the second duration (30 days). Changed by the user unless tc-duration-change is prevented

properties.name: allowPermanent
properties.description: Offers Permanent as a duration

properties.name: minJustification
properties.description: The fewest characters a justification may have

properties.name: maxJustification
properties.description: The most characters a justification may have

properties.name: fields
properties.description: The fields or columns that may be asked for; empty hides the choice

properties.name: referenceLabel
properties.description: The optional reference field's label; empty hides it

properties.name: status
properties.description: Where the request stands. Changed by the element unless a tc-status-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: approvers
properties.description: Who decides, shown while pending

properties.name: submittedAt
properties.description: When the request was sent, epoch ms; set by the element when it sends one

properties.name: expiresAt
properties.description: When granted access ends, epoch ms; unset while approved means permanent

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Why the request was denied

properties.name: now
properties.description: The clock for "time left", epoch ms – unset uses an internal clock

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The language for dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-request
events.description: The form was sent ({ level, duration, until, justification, reference, fields }: AccessRequestDetail); cancelable – prevented, the form stays as it is

events.name: tc-status-change
events.description: The status is about to change: pending after a request, draft after Cancel or Request again ({ status }: AccessStatusChange); cancelable – prevented, `status` stays as it was

events.name: tc-level-change
events.description: A level was picked ({ level }: AccessLevelChange); cancelable – prevented, `level` stays as it was

events.name: tc-duration-change
events.description: A duration was picked ({ duration }: AccessDurationChange); cancelable – prevented, `duration` stays as it was

events.name: tc-cancel
events.description: Cancel request was used on a pending request ({ status }: AccessCancel); cancelable – prevented, the request stays pending

functions.name: defaultAccessLevels
functions.description: The levels offered when the page gives none

functions.name: defaultAccessDurations
functions.description: The fixed durations offered when the page gives none; an end date and permanent are added by the element

functions.name: defaultAccessClassifications
functions.signature: defaultAccessClassifications: Record<string, { label: string; tone: AccessTone }>
functions.description: The classifications' names and tones used when the page gives none

props.name: status
props.description: Where the request stands – controlled when given

props.name: defaultStatus
props.description: The status on mount when `status` isn't controlled

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: The status changed: pending after a request, draft after Cancel or Request again

props.name: level
props.description: The picked level – controlled when given

props.name: defaultLevel
props.description: The level on mount when `level` isn't controlled

props.name: duration
props.description: The picked duration – controlled when given

props.name: defaultDuration
props.description: The duration on mount when `duration` isn't controlled

props.name: onRequest
props.description: The form was sent; return false to keep the form as it is (e.g. the request failed)

props.name: onCancelRequest
props.description: Cancel request was used; return false to keep the request pending

changelog: `tc-access-request` – ask for access to one piece of data: level, duration, justification, fields; then pending, approved, denied or expired.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: field-sizing
features.without: Text fields grow with their text. Without it they keep their minimum height and scroll.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
